description: The signed-in user's websites that were down at their latest check, plus the changes found in the last 7 days (website.down, website.recovered; newest first, at most 50). Connecty checks each site when it is added and then once a day at 08:00 UTC, so this is not live; the only notification Connecty sends itself is an optional email after the daily check that the user can switch on in the dashboard. Suited to a daily scheduled task in your assistant (for example after 09:00 UTC) that reports only when a site is down or changed. Requires sign-in.
name: get_status_changes
title: Get my status changes
